description: Monitor your Wi-Fi connection at a glance with a sleek, customizable widget. Keep your Wi-Fi connection details right where you need them: on your home screen. WiFi Widget is a free, open-source Android app that displays detailed Wi-Fi information in a customizable home screen widget. Choose what to show, arrange it your way, and check or copy connection details directly in the app. Wi-Fi and network details • Connection: SSID, BSSID, frequency, channel, link speed, RSSI, signal strength, Wi-Fi standard, generation and security protocol • IP addresses: local and public addresses, IPv4 and IPv6, prefix lengths and IPv4 subnet masks • Network configuration: gateway, DNS servers, DHCP and NAT64 prefix • Internet details: ISP, ASN and approximate IP-based location • IP coordinates associated with your public IP address Customize your home screen widget • Select the properties you want to display and reorder them • Choose light or dark themes, dynamic or custom colors, and background opacity • Adjust font size, text alignment and widget size • Add buttons to refresh data or open Wi-Fi settings; configure the widget in the app or from your launcher • Set automatic refresh intervals from 15 minutes to 24 hours; Android may defer background updates Useful beyond the home screen • View your current Wi-Fi status and connection details in the app • Tap property values to copy them to the clipboard • Enjoy a Material 3 Expressive interface with light, dark and AMOLED black themes • No ads Some information requires internet access or Android location permissions. Available properties may vary by device and Android version. WiFi Widget is open source under the GPL-3.0 license. Source code: https://github.com/w2sv/WiFi-Widget
